title: Oily Outrageous Argentinian Parma Ham Empanadas
description: A tangy and shaggy Argentinian dish featuring parma ham, perfect for a post-workout snack, made with ayurvedic sattvic friendly ingredients. This empanada is deep fried to a crispy golden brown.
instructions: Preheat the oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees.
Roll out the empanada dough to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
Cut out circles of dough using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass.
Place a tablespoon of parma ham, onion, and hard boiled egg in the center of each dough circle.
Brush the edges of the dough with olive oil and fold the dough in half to form a half moon shape.
Press the edges together to seal the empanada.
Fry the empanadas in batches until they are golden brown.
Drain the empanadas on paper towels and sprinkle with salt, black pepper, and paprika.
Serve the empanadas hot and enjoy.
